newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF's Mitsuzuka says Nomura affair 'regrettable'.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Mitsuzuka says Nomura affair 'regrettable'.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Thursday it was "extremely regrettable" that Nomura Securities Co Ltd executives had become the subject of an investigation and legal complaint.

He added that, following regular procedures, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC) would submit recommendations to the finance minister regarding what punitive measures should be taken against Nomura after it confirms the facts.
"Upon receiving the recommendations, we will deal with (Nomura) in a strict manner," he said. "What has happened twice should not happen a third time."
This is the second time Nomura has been involved in a major financial scandal in recent years.
